facts.fact: ZICTA reports a Board assessment tour of Universal Access and Service Fund ICT projects in Muchinga, Northern and Luapula Provinces, evaluating how they bridge the connectivity gap in unserved and underserved communities.

ZICTA donated to Chinsali Special School in 2024 15 desktop computers, five with JAWS screen-reading software, plus a braille printer and internet connectivity, for a school of 768 learners including 213 with disabilities.
